name: Sylo-Fluxer
description: BETA: Sylo-Fluxer runs on Fluxer and every module is ported, but it started life as a Discord bot and some features don't work as expected yet - see "Beta status" in the project README before relying on it. Sylo-Fluxer is a multi-function bot for Fluxer (https://fluxer.app) with a web dashboard - a port of Sylo. It has a per-community module system: moderation with warning thresholds and a numbered case log, server logging, tickets/modmail answered from the dashboard, reaction roles & autoroles, verification (react to verify, or a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha), welcome/leave messages, birthdays, sticky messages, auto-moderation, counting, custom commands, an autoresponder, reminders, leveling (text + voice XP), AFK, server statistics, server insights, free games, ban appeals, temporary voice channels, a starboard, an invite tracker, polls, giveaways, game stats, Twitch / YouTube / Kick / RSS alerts, scheduled channel cleanup and a message/embed creator. Commands are typed with a prefix (! by default, changeable per community). State is stored in a single SQLite file under /app/data and survives updates; it is snapshotted automatically into /app/data/backups. Setup: in the Fluxer app open User Settings -> Developer -> Applications, create an application, then set FLUXER_TOKEN (Bot token) and FLUXER_CLIENT_ID (Application ID). Invite the bot with https://web.fluxer.app/oauth2/authorize?client_id=YOUR_APPLICATION_ID&scope=bot&permissions=1100469103831 Dashboard: runs open (no login) until you turn on "Log in with Fluxer" - use it only on a trusted LAN until then. To restrict it to community owners / admins, set FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET (Client secret, same page), DASHBOARD_URL (the URL you open the dashboard on), SESSION_SECRET and OWNER_IDS, and add DASHBOARD_URL/auth/fluxer/callback to the application's Redirect URIs.

paths.name: Data Directory
paths.description: Where the SQLite database (sylo.db) is stored. Persists across updates/restarts.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Host port for the Sylo dashboard. Only change the host side; the container always listens on 3000.

variables.name: FLUXER_TOKEN
variables.description: Fluxer bot token (User Settings -> Developer -> Applications -> your app -> Bot token).

variables.name: FLUXER_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Fluxer Application ID (top of the same page).

variables.name: FLUXER_SHARD_COUNT
variables.description: Optional. Number of gateway shards this one container runs. Leave blank (or 'auto') - it stays at 1 until the bot is in ~2,500+ communities. Multi-process sharding is not supported.

variables.name: FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Set this (same page -> Client secret) to require 'Log in with Fluxer' on the dashboard, restricted to community admins. Also add http:// :[HOST-PORT]/auth/fluxer/callback to the application's Redirect URIs. Leave blank to run the dashboard open (trusted LAN only).

variables.name: FLUXER_API_URL
variables.description: Optional, self-hosted Fluxer only. Public API origin of your instance. Leave blank for hosted Fluxer (fluxer.app).

variables.name: FLUXER_WEB_URL
variables.description: Optional, self-hosted Fluxer only. Web app origin of your instance. Leave blank for hosted Fluxer.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_URL
variables.description: Optional. The public dashboard URL (e.g. https://sylo.example.com or http:// :[HOST-PORT]). Needed behind a reverse proxy for the OAuth2 redirect URI, and to build the links members open for verification-captcha and ban appeals. Leave blank for direct IP access without those features.

variables.name: SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Recommended with FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET. Any long random string (e.g. from 'openssl rand -hex 32') that signs dashboard sessions. If blank a random one is generated at start, so everyone is logged out on every restart.

variables.name: OWNER_IDS
variables.description: Recommended with FLUXER_CLIENT_SECRET. Your Fluxer user id(s), comma-separated. Only these accounts can open the Health page (status, error log, database backup / restore) once login is on.

variables.name: DEV_LOG_CHANNEL_ID
variables.description: Optional. A Fluxer channel id where Sylo posts its own errors and warnings. Sylo must be in that community and able to send embeds there.

variables.name: FLUXER_TIMESTAMPS
variables.description: How times render in bot messages: native (the t:... markup, shown in each reader's timezone) or text (plain UTC). Use text if times show up as raw markup.

variables.name: TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile site key — enables the Verification module's captcha mode. Free at dash.cloudflare.com -> Turnstile. Needs both keys and DASHBOARD_URL set; otherwise captcha mode falls back to reacting with ✅ to verify.

variables.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile secret key — pairs with TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY for the Verification captcha.

variables.name: ITAD_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional. IsThereAnyDeal API key (free at isthereanydeal.com/apps) — broadens the Free games module beyond the Epic Games Store to Steam, GOG, Fanatical, Humble and more. Without it, Free games is Epic-only.

variables.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Twitch application client id for the Twitch alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at dev.twitch.tv/console. Needs TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

variables.name: TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Twitch application client secret, paired with TWITCH_CLIENT_ID for the Twitch alerts module.

variables.name: KICK_CLIENT_ID
variables.description: Optional. Kick application client id for the Kick alerts module ('go live' notifications). Free app at kick.com/settings/developer. Needs KICK_CLIENT_SECRET too; without both, the module's poll loop does nothing.

variables.name: KICK_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.description: Optional. Kick application client secret, paired with KICK_CLIENT_ID for the Kick alerts module.

variables.name: STATS_CACHE_TTL_MINUTES
variables.description: How long (minutes) to cache a stats lookup before hitting the API again.

variables.name: GAMETOOLS_API_BASE
variables.description: Base URL of the Battlefield stats API.

variables.name: DATABASE_PATH
variables.description: Path to the SQLite file inside the container. Must sit inside the Data Directory mount.

variables.name: BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS
variables.description: How often (hours) to write an automatic compacted database snapshot into Data Directory/backups. A snapshot is also always taken just before a schema migration, and on demand from the Health page. Set to 0 to disable the scheduled backup.

variables.name: BACKUP_RETENTION
variables.description: How many database snapshots to keep in Data Directory/backups. Older ones are pruned automatically.

variables.name: BACKUP_DIR
variables.description: Optional. Directory (inside the container) for database snapshots. Leave blank to use Data Directory/backups; must sit inside the Data Directory mount if set.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL
variables.description: Optional. Off-site backups: a WebDAV folder URL (e.g. a Nextcloud path like https://cloud.example.com/remote.php/dav/files/me/sylo-backups). After every local snapshot a gzipped copy is PUT to url/name.db.gz. Best-effort and logged; never blocks the local backup.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_USER
variables.description: Optional. Username for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL (HTTP basic auth). Use an app password, not your account password.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBDAV_PASS
variables.description: Optional. Password / app password for BACKUP_WEBDAV_URL.

variables.name: BACKUP_WEBHOOK_URL
variables.description: Optional. Off-site backups: a webhook URL. Each gzipped snapshot is uploaded as an attachment (skipped when it is over ~8 MiB — use WebDAV for a larger database).

variables.name: WEB_PORT
variables.description: Port the app listens on inside the container. Leave at 3000 unless you also change the container side of the WebUI Port mapping.

variables.name: NODE_ENV
variables.description: Node environment.

variables.name: LOG_LEVEL
variables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn or error. debug also emits one line per HTTP request.

variables.name: LOG_FORMAT
variables.description: Log line format: text or json (LOG_JSON=1 is shorthand for json).

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: IANA timezone name, used for timestamps in ticket transcripts and logs. Defaults to Europe/Oslo.
